svg.title: IRONBOUND — Manticore Heavy Tank — Standard
svg.desc: Ground vehicle record. Override tactical conversion; IRONBOUND criticals and movement. EV uses standard BV2 G4/P5; crew paid separately.

g.text: Initiative remains at the printed base bracket.
AI: anti-infantry. IF: indirect fire. TU: turret; FR: front; BD: body.
Each row is one bin; shared by listed TICs. Spend 1 shot per weapon fired.
Equipment: Fusion engine; standard structure; standard armor; turret.
Any location reduced to 0 Structure: destroyed.
